jobs.title: Associate Product Manager (New Grad)
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

From day one, we've been breaking down barriers, empowering people with the tools, knowledge, and products to participate in the financial system. Our innovation doesn't stop — and we need bright, curious minds to help shape the future of finance!

As an Associate Product Manager, you'll be at the center of our product innovation. You'll work alongside top talent from engineering, design, research, and more to bring groundbreaking financial products to life. From simplifying complex financial processes to crafting seamless customer experiences, your work will help shape the future of fintech. This role offers direct mentorship from some of the most accomplished product leaders in the industry, giving you the chance to grow, learn, and make a real impact in a fast-paced, cutting-edge environment.

This role is based in our New York, NY office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

- Collaborate with engineering, design, research, data science, and marketing teams to deeply understand our customers and their most pressing needs

- Define and execute product strategies that align with business goals and user expectations

- Be the voice of the product, facilitating communication and collaboration across teams

- Lead product launches, ensuring they are delivered on time and meet a high standard of quality

- Set and monitor KPIs to measure success and track product engagement and adoption

What you bring

- Currently enrolled in a full-time, degree-seeking program in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics, or a related field, graduating between Winter 2026 and Summer 2027

- 0–1 years of experience in product management, product development, or related roles; internship or co-op experience in fintech or tech is a plus

- Sharp analytical and technical skills, a problem-solving mindset, and the ability to make data-driven decisions

- Demonstrated leadership and communication abilities, with experience thriving in collaborative, cross-functional teams

- An entrepreneurial spirit — takes ownership of projects, turns ideas into action, and drives innovation

- A passion for fintech and a desire to learn more about financial products, markets, and emerging technologies

What we offer

- Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career

- Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching

- Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents

- Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds

- Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not

- Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more

- Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits

- Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

- Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

Base Pay Range:

Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC)
$130,000 — $130,000 USD

jobs.description:

The Robinhood International & Crypto team’s mission is to democratize finance for all by making investing simple, safe, and accessible. We’re a collaborative group of marketers, product thinkers, and strategists working together to drive adoption and engagement expansion markets.

As a Product Marketing Manager , you’ll play a key role in how we connect with customers and drive growth for Robinhood in expansion markets. In this role, you’ll lead go-to-market strategy for new products and features and help shape the product growth strategy for our brokerage and crypto offering in a highly regulated and fast-moving environment. We’re looking for a consumer product marketer who can build and execute strategies that drive awareness, adoption, and growth, partnering closely with cross-functional teams across product, creative, research, legal, compliance, and more!

This role is based in our Luxembourg office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

- Own product marketing for Robinhood in expansion markets, leading positioning and go-to-market strategy for new products and features, as well as evergreen initiatives that drive adoption and engagement.

- Partner with product, lifecycle, performance, creative, social, events, communications, legal, and compliance to define and deliver strategic growth initiatives.

- Serve as a strategic advisor to product teams, helping inform roadmaps and product improvements based on user insights, market feedback, and regional learnings.

- Develop differentiated narratives and messaging informed by user insights, testing, and a deep understanding of the target audience

- Craft marketing plans and creative direction that drive relevance, adoption, and sustained engagement for Robinhood.

- Define success metrics and track impact in partnership with product and data science teams, ensuring alignment with legal and compliance requirements.

What you bring

- 7+ years experience in product marketing (or adjacent consumer growth/product roles) in tech.

- Strong growth marketing leadership, including shaping positioning, messaging, and integrated launch plans across channels.

- Ability to break down complex concepts so they’re simple, clear, and human.

- Strong relationship-building skills and ability to lead cross-functionally through influence.

- Data-informed decision making, including familiarity with experimentation and performance measurement.

- Fluency across key marketing channels (e.g., lifecycle, performance, in-product, and social) and how to sequence them for impact.

- Comfort operating in regulated consumer products and partnering closely with legal and compliance teams.

- Thrives in a fast-paced environment with a bias toward action.

What we offer

- Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.

- Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact and bonus programs.

- Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs.

- Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more.

- Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more!

- Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

- Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Capital Markets
jobs.location: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers, sharp problem-solvers and builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. Private markets have been closed to everyday investors for decades. The Capital Markets team is opening them. As the Product Manager for this team you will own the products that give retail investors access to companies before they reach the public markets including:

- IPO Access, which distributes pre-IPO share allocations to our customers

- Robinhood Ventures, our family of publicly traded funds holding direct positions in the world’s best private companies

- New products you will define to give investors direct access to individual private companies and alternative investments.

As a Senior Product Manager on Capital Markets, you will own these product lines end to end and help shape where all three go next. You’ll own the strategy and products that help everyday investors access IPOs, Private Companies, Alternatives and more. You'll work with our top tier engineers, designers, researchers, data scientists, and investing team to ship industry-changing products that revolutionize access to private markets. Today private markets are the largest category of assets ordinary investors cannot touch. This is a chance to change that.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do

- Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for one of the Capital Markets product lines - IPO Access, Robinhood Ventures, or single-asset private offerings - and contribute to the strategy across all three

- Lead 0-1 launches, including the in-app experience for investing in a single private asset and the discovery surfaces that make private markets navigable for a first-time investor

- Translate ambiguous regulatory, operational, and partner requirements into clear, dependable customer experiences, working shoulder to shoulder with legal, compliance, and operations

- Build and manage relationships with external partners - issuers, underwriters, fund administrators, and infrastructure vendors - so that a shared product actually ships

- Set the quality bar for a product line where a confusing flow costs customers real money and real trust

- Use research, experimentation, and product analytics to decide what to build, and to prove what worked

- Communicate strategy, tradeoffs, and the reasoning behind them to senior leadership

What you bring

- 5+ years of product management experience building and shipping high-quality consumer or consumer fintech products

- A track record of shipping 0-1 products at scale, beyond prototypes and pilots

- Comfort with financial products that carry genuine complexity - you can become an expert in a new instrument, offering structure, or regulatory regime quickly.

- Experience working with legal, compliance, operations, or other regulated-product stakeholders, and the judgment to know when to push and when to redesign

- Experience working with 3rd-party partners on large-scale projects to deliver a shared product

- Strong product judgment and the ability to turn an ambiguous opportunity into a clear strategy, roadmap, and execution plan

- Ability to operate in unclear, 0-1 situations while sustaining a high quality bar under real time pressure

- Demonstrated history of using research, experimentation, and analytics to guide decision making

- Clear communication and relationship management skills, with experience influencing across highly cross-functional teams and with external partners

- Passion for Robinhood's mission to democratize finance for all, and excitement about opening an asset class that has been closed to most investors

- Experience and proficiency building through the latest AI tools such as Claude Code, Gemini, Cursor, or ChatGPT

- Nice to have - familiarity with private markets or alternatives - closed-end funds, BDCs, interval funds, SPVs, Reg D offerings, or the IPO / ECM process.

What we offer

- Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career

- Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership

- Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs

- Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more.

- Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more!

- Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

- Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Gold Growth
jobs.location: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

Robinhood Gold is our premium membership and one of the most important businesses at Robinhood. For one monthly fee, Gold members unlock a bundle of benefits, including boosted APY on uninvested cash, an IRA match, lower margin rates, professional research, access to the Robinhood Gold Card, and more. The Gold Growth team is responsible for growing that membership: how customers discover Gold, why they start a trial, what convinces them to become paying members, and what keeps them subscribed. Because Gold touches nearly every product at Robinhood, we reach customers across the entire app, and our work directly drives subscription revenue and how much of their financial lives customers choose to bring to Robinhood.

As Senior Product Manager, Gold Growth, you will own key levers of the Gold growth funnel and be accountable for business outcomes, not just feature metrics. You will decide where to invest across acquisition, trial-to-paid conversion, engagement, and retention, make clear trade-offs between growth, member value, and unit economics, and partner closely with data science to run high-velocity experiments, and read results with rigor. You will work hand in hand with design to craft simple, compelling consumer experiences, and you will operate with a high degree of autonomy: taking ambiguous problems, forming a point of view, and driving them to launch with little day-to-day guidance.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do

- Own the strategy and roadmap for Gold growth across the full member lifecycle, from discovery and trial to paid conversion, activation of benefits, and long-term retention.
